conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: There’s a ₹200 charge on my savings account for no reason! What’s this about?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the confusion Sir. Can you share your account number to check the charge?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s six nine zero, six one nine, zero eight, five two. I never signed up for any extra fees!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I see it’s a maintenance fee due to a low balance. I can waive it as a one-time courtesy.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Waive it? Why’s it there in the first place? Explain!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: The account requires a minimum balance of ₹10,000. I’ve waived the fee and can set up balance alerts for you.
